learningObjectives.description: Integrate spiritual formation with academic learning

notes.summary:
": "In this module, we have explored the core concepts of AI and robotics, their applications, and ethical considerations through a biblical lens. We have seen how these technologies can serve humanity and reflect God's creativity when approached with wisdom and responsibility.",
  "keyTakeaways": [
    "AI and robotics are powerful tools that can enhance human life when guided by ethical principles.",
    "A biblical understanding of wisdom and stewardship informs our approach to technology.",
    "Future advancements in AI and robotics present both opportunities and challenges that require thoughtful engagement."
  ],
  "furtherReading": [
    "Russell, Stuart, and Norvig, Peter. 'Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach.'",
    "Bostrom, Nick. 'Superintelligence: Paths, Dangers, Strategies.'",
    "Heath, Joseph, and Andrew Potter. 'Dealing with Complexity: A Guide to the Ethics of AI and Robotics.'"
  ]
}
```
